Tidewell Shop Our story Find us FAQ Journal

Sparkling cold-brewed tea

Tidewell is sparkling cold-brewed tea, brewed slowly in Portland and canned while it is still bright. No syrups, no sweeteners, just tea, a little fruit and bubbles.

We started on a single stall at a neighbourhood market and now you can find us in shops across Portland and Seattle. Pick up a can after your Saturday run or order a mixed case from our shop.

Four flavours, all in 12oz cans: Black Tea and Lemon, Green Tea and Yuzu, Hibiscus and Berry, and Oolong and Peach.

Tidewell Beverage Co. · Portland, Oregon. This is a fictional brand used to demonstrate Landfall.

Shop

Every Tidewell flavour comes in a 12oz can. Choose a mixed case or a case of one flavour.

Flavours

  • Black Tea and Lemon
  • Green Tea and Yuzu
  • Hibiscus and Berry
  • Oolong and Peach

A case of 12 cans is $36. A mixed case of 24 cans is $68. We currently list 14 products across our four flavours, including gift boxes.

Tidewell Beverage Co. · Portland, Oregon. This is a fictional brand used to demonstrate Landfall.

Tidewell Shop Our story Find us FAQ Journal

Find us

You can find Tidewell at 41 neighbourhood shops across Portland and Seattle.

In Portland look for us at independent grocers, coffee shops and bottle shops from Alberta Street to Sellwood. In Seattle we are in shops in Capitol Hill, Ballard and Fremont.

Want to stock Tidewell? Email wholesale@tidewell.example and we will be in touch.

Tidewell Beverage Co. · Portland, Oregon. This is a fictional brand used to demonstrate Landfall.

Tidewell Shop Our story Find us FAQ Journal

Shipping and questions

Where do you ship? We ship within the US only. We do not ship internationally yet.

How long does delivery take? Orders leave our Portland warehouse within two working days and usually arrive within a week.

Is there caffeine? Yes, every flavour contains caffeine from the tea, between 30 and 45mg per can.

Tidewell Beverage Co. · Portland, Oregon. This is a fictional brand used to demonstrate Landfall.

Tidewell Shop Our story Find us FAQ Journal

Journal

Running with our neighbours. This season Tidewell sponsors two Portland run clubs, the Alberta Arts Runners and the Sellwood Striders. Look for our cooler at the finish of their Saturday morning runs.

New flavour. Oolong and Peach joined the range in spring.

Tidewell Beverage Co. · Portland, Oregon. This is a fictional brand used to demonstrate Landfall.

system.text: You check whether a verbatim quote from a web page supports a claim exactly as it is shown to a founder. Each claim has a field, a label and a value, and together they are the claim: field 'founded', label 'Founded', value '2009' means 'the brand was founded in 2009'. First restate that full claim in claim_as_read. Then judge it. SUPPORTED: the quote itself states the full claim; a paraphrase or a translation is fine. PARTIAL: the quote supports only part of it, or the claim needs an inference beyond the quote (for example 'our cans are sold in Seattle' does not state 'the brand is based in Seattle'). Dates: a year in which something was done (selling, making, developing, shipping since a year) is not a founding date; only a quote saying the company was founded, established, started or launched then supports one. NOT_SUPPORTED: the quote does not support the claim. Judge only from the quote, never from what you know about the brand.
